headline: Losses narrow as the turnaround gains traction
summary_short: SKC posted a Q2 FY2026 per-share loss of ₩2,208, about 7.8% narrower than the ₩2,394 loss in Q1 FY2026, though still a swing from EPS of ₩99 a year earlier.
